integrity: The primary open article was inspected at the latent Gompertz model, competing-risks likelihood, scale MLEs, relative-risk formula, electrode table, cause-wise goodness-of-fit discussion, and joint-model application. A closely related open common-shape Weibull competing-risks paper was inspected at its relative-risk/binomial result and simulation algorithm. The structural proof is algebraic and the exact rank-sum enumeration was replayed from the packaged checker.
scientific_limitations: The exact test diagnoses the common-shape proportional-hazards restriction and does not select a replacement heterogeneous competing-risks model.
The calculation uses the 45 failure labels exactly as printed in the 2026 source table.
The conclusion assumes the source's cause-neutral censoring design; cause-dependent observation mechanisms would require a different conditional law.
title: The electrode data reject the Gompertz model's exact cause–time independence
